fields.label: Default Source Warehouse
fields.description: Default warehouse from which raw materials are consumed. Can be overridden per Work Order or per BOM Item row.

fields.label: Default WIP Warehouse
fields.description: Work-in-Progress warehouse. Set this to enable the 'Issue Materials' step on Work Orders.

fields.label: Default Finished Goods Warehouse
fields.description: Default warehouse where finished manufactured goods are received.

fields.label: Default Scrap Warehouse
fields.description: Default warehouse for recoverable scrap / by-products.

fields.label: Auto-Create Job Cards on Work Order Submit
fields.description: If enabled, a Job Card is automatically created for every operation when a Work Order is submitted.

fields.label: Over-Production Allowance (%)
fields.description: Percentage of the planned quantity that may be over-produced without an error. E.g. 5 means up to 105% of qty is allowed.

fields.label: Allow Negative Stock
fields.description: If enabled, manufacturing stock entries will proceed even if stock goes below zero. Not recommended for production.

fields.label: Backflush Raw Materials Based On
fields.description: BOM: consume qty proportional to the BOM at completion time. 'Material Transferred': consume exactly what was issued to WIP.

fields.label: Set Rate of Sub-Assembly Item Based on BOM
fields.description: If enabled, the cost of a sub-assembly material row is taken from the linked Sub-Assembly BOM's total cost instead of the Item's valuation rate.

fields.label: Job Card Hours per Day
fields.description: Used for capacity planning calculations to estimate how many days an operation takes.

fields.label: Capacity Planning Horizon (Days)
fields.description: How many days ahead to plan production capacity.

fields.label: Segregate Scrap/By-Product GL
fields.description: If enabled, recoverable scrap/by-products received from a Work Order post to the company's Default Scrap/By-Product Account (Books Company) instead of the Default Inventory Account, for audit/reporting segregation. Falls back to the Default Inventory Account if no Scrap account is configured, so GL always balances. Off by default — existing companies are unaffected until they opt in.

fields.label: Warn if BOM selected is not the Default BOM
fields.description: Show a warning when a Work Order uses a non-default BOM for the item.

fields.label: Warn if Job Cards are Incomplete on Finish
fields.description: Show a warning when completing a Work Order that still has open Job Cards.
